questions.question: Which game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Minecraft was first created by a Swedish programmer called Markus Persson, known as Notch.

questions.question: In Minecraft, which green mob creeps up on you and explodes?
questions.explanation: Creepers sneak up silently and hiss just before they go bang.

questions.question: What is the name of Sonic the Hedgehog's two-tailed fox friend?
questions.explanation: Tails can fly by spinning his two tails like a helicopter.

questions.question: In Minecraft, which block do you need to build a Nether portal?
questions.explanation: Obsidian forms where water meets lava, and only a diamond or netherite pickaxe can mine it.

questions.question: Which game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Every Fortnite Battle Royale match starts with players jumping out of the Battle Bus.

questions.question: Which game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Banana skins and green shells have been in Mario Kart since the very first game in 1992.

questions.question: In Pokémon, what does Charmander become when it first evolves?
questions.explanation: Charmeleon then evolves again into the mighty Charizard.

questions.question: In Among Us, what are the sneaky players trying to sabotage the ship called?
questions.explanation: The Crewmates must finish their tasks or vote the Impostors off the ship.

questions.question: Which game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The birds are cross because the green pigs stole their eggs.

questions.question: In The Legend of Zelda games, what is the name of the hero you play as?
questions.explanation: Lots of people think the hero is called Zelda, but she is the princess.

questions.question: In which game do you play a naughty goose causing chaos in an English village?
questions.explanation: Untitled Goose Game was made by a small team called House House in Melbourne, Australia.

questions.question: In Animal Crossing: New Horizons, who sells you your island getaway and your house loan?
questions.explanation: Tom Nook is a tanuki, a kind of Japanese raccoon dog.

questions.question: How many ghosts chase Pac-Man around the maze?
questions.explanation: They are called Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde.

questions.question: In Tetris, what are the falling pieces called?
questions.explanation: Every Tetris piece is made of four squares, which is where the name comes from.

questions.question: EA's football games used to be called FIFA. What are they called now?
questions.explanation: The games were called FIFA for 30 years until the name changed in 2023.

questions.question: Which company created Sonic the Hedgehog?
questions.explanation: Sonic was created in 1991 as Sega's speedy answer to Nintendo's Mario.

questions.question: In which year was the original Pac-Man arcade game released?
questions.explanation: Creator Toru Iwatani has said a pizza with a slice missing was partly the inspiration for Pac-Man's shape.

questions.question: What was Mario called in the original 1981 Donkey Kong arcade game?
questions.explanation: In Donkey Kong, Mario was a carpenter, not yet a plumber.

questions.question: Master Chief is the hero of which video game series?
questions.explanation: Halo: Combat Evolved launched alongside the first Xbox in 2001.

questions.question: Which arcade game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Taito's Space Invaders was a massive arcade hit when it came out in 1978.

questions.question: Which arcade game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Konami's Frogger came out in 1981, decades before Crossy Road borrowed the idea.

questions.question: Which game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Snake came built into Nokia mobile phones from 1997.

questions.question: Which game do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Every Sim has a green diamond, called a plumbob, floating over their head.

questions.question: Lara Croft is the heroine of which video game series?
questions.explanation: The first Tomb Raider, in 1996, was made by Core Design in Derby.

questions.question: Which handheld console, launched in 1989, came with Tetris in the box in the UK and America?
questions.explanation: Tetris and the Game Boy turned out to be one of the most successful pairings in gaming.

questions.question: Which tech giant bought Minecraft's maker, Mojang, in 2014?
questions.explanation: Microsoft paid about 2.5 billion dollars for Mojang.

questions.question: The Grand Theft Auto series began at DMA Design in which Scottish city?
questions.explanation: DMA Design also made Lemmings, and later became Rockstar North in Edinburgh.

questions.question: In which game do you inherit your grandfather's old farm near Pelican Town?
questions.explanation: Stardew Valley was made almost entirely by one person, Eric Barone.

questions.question: What was the Sega Mega Drive called in North America?
questions.explanation: Saturn and Dreamcast were later Sega consoles, and the Master System came before.

questions.question: Sports Interactive's Championship Manager series carried on under which new name from 2004?
questions.explanation: The studio kept making the game but lost the Championship Manager name to its publisher, Eidos.
